scope: Planning metadata only. No DarwinG60 driver implementation or hardware support is implied.

drivers.name: Display and touchscreen
drivers.scope: Panel output, display modes, touch input and gesture events.
drivers.hardware: Display and touch controller identifiers and interfaces require device-specific verification.
gaps: Identify panel and touch-controller variants from reliable device documentation.
Research display pipeline and touch event interfaces.

drivers.name: GPU
drivers.scope: Graphics device discovery, command submission research and rendering acceleration.
drivers.hardware: Adreno 618 is listed in published Moto G60 specifications; low-level interface details remain to be researched.
gaps: Research the documented GPU software stack and licensing constraints.
Define a future graphics abstraction without assuming acceleration works.

drivers.name: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
drivers.scope: Wireless networking, radio control and Bluetooth device communication.
drivers.hardware: Exact wireless chipset and firmware requirements need verified device-specific evidence.
gaps: Identify wireless chipset and supported interfaces.
Document firmware and driver availability; no radio control is implemented.

drivers.name: Battery and charging
drivers.scope: Battery telemetry, charging state, thermal signals and power policy.
drivers.hardware: Fuel-gauge, charger and thermal interfaces are not yet identified for this profile.
gaps: Research battery and charging telemetry interfaces.
Design a safe read-only power status abstraction.

drivers.name: Audio
drivers.scope: Audio routing, playback, capture and codec research.
drivers.hardware: Audio codec and routing details require device-specific verification.
gaps: Identify audio codec and audio-routing architecture.

drivers.name: Sensors
drivers.scope: Sensor discovery and standardized motion, orientation and environmental events.
drivers.hardware: Sensor inventory and bus connections require reliable device-specific evidence.
gaps: Define a common sensor event model.

drivers.name: Storage
drivers.scope: Storage-controller research, block-device abstraction and filesystem integration.
drivers.hardware: Storage controller and partition details require device-specific verification.
gaps: Verify storage controller and media details from trusted sources.
Design host-testable block-device interfaces; no partition access is implemented.
